title: Implement fail-closed account-scoped mobile translation
acceptance_criteria: Translation is explicitly scoped to the active account and never sends the source text as fallback
Empty unchanged same-script explanatory prefixed or suspicious model output is blocked before send
A translated draft is previewed and requires an explicit user send action
Provider keys are never embedded in the APK and failed requests preserve the source draft
required_evidence: Desktop safety-regression parity tests Android unit lint build and physical-device UI evidence
